summary: Stay of execution proceedings under Consumer Protection Act during IBC moratorium; Section 96 IBC applicability to personal guarantors; penalties as 'debt' under IBC; execution as recovery proceeding; distinction between civil, quasi-criminal, and criminal proceedings; precedent from P. Mohanraj, SBI v. V. Ramakrishnan, Ajay Kumar Goenka; moratorium scope; preferential payment risk; double jeopardy argument; NCDRC order challenged; interim relief implications.
